subject: LatticeWorks RFP: SIG/ISO/SOC2 - control crosswalk and artifact timeline
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@latticeworks.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: security-review@latticeworks.com
Date: 2027-10-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP — SIG/ISO/SOC2: control mapping and evidence requests

Hi Soojin and Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this RFP. LatticeWorks is evaluating vendors this quarter and we need a consolidated crosswalk for SIG/ISO/SOC2 mapped to product capabilities and sample artifacts. Our procurement timeline is tight — we need a first pass by EOD Tuesday (2027-10-19).

Key asks in this packet:
- A control crosswalk (mapping vendor control IDs to SIG/ISO/SOC2 controls)
- Representative artifacts or links for technical controls (encryption at rest/in transit, key management, scoping)
- Clarification on shared responsibility for telemetry and retention windows
- Confirmation that private deployments can be audited via customer-provided tooling (if applicable)

We prefer a single spreadsheet and a short narrative for any exceptions. Also include a point-of-contact for a concise 30-min call this week to walk the security team through any non-standard controls.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Procurement Lead — LatticeWorks
Procurement Team <procurement@latticeworks.com>

[Attachment: Lattice-RFP-AppendixA.pdf (PDF)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@latticeworks.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-17T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP — SIG/ISO/SOC2: control mapping and evidence requests

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. We can meet the Tuesday EOD target with a staged deliverable:

1) Today (within 48 hours): a condensed control crosswalk spreadsheet that maps SIG to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls and flags any controls that require customer-facing evidence or configuration (we'll mark owner: Redwood / Customer).
2) By Monday EOD: a small artifact bundle (redacted logs, configuration screenshots, and a KMS summary) and an evidence index pointing to the Drive folder you shared.
3) If you want, we can schedule a 30-min call on Mon/Tue for the security reviewers; Karthik can lead the deep-dive on encryption and telemetry.

I'm attaching a short crosswalk template (RI-Control-Crosswalk-v1.xlsx) and an evidence index CSV to populate. For now, we'll use the following assumptions unless you flag otherwise:
- Hosted API: Redwood is responsible for runtime server controls; customer responsible for application-layer data handling and prompt/content.
- Dedicated/Private: Customer can request a scope extension for auditing; we'll surface available logs and KMS artifacts as defined in the crosswalk.

Action items: please confirm the artifacts you most need (logs/KMS proofs/network diagrams) and whether we should include a copy of our SOC 2 Type II report in the initial bundle.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: RI-Control-Crosswalk-v1.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@latticeworks.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-18T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP — SIG/ISO/SOC2: control mapping and evidence requests

Alex / team — quick note from the security side. A few points we'll include in the artifact packet and want you to confirm if you need the following evidentiary formats:

- KMS proof: key rotation history and signed KMS policy excerpts (we can provide redacted rotation logs and an architecture diagram showing HSM/KMS relationship).
- Network segmentation evidence: VPC/subnet diagrams and sample flow logs (redacted).
- Telemetry & retention: example retention policy, example audit log entries, and a short runbook for on-demand exports.

I attached a short KMS summary (RI-KMS-Summary.pdf) and added inline notes in the crosswalk. Two asks for you: (1) please confirm if we should include customer-tenant telemetry extracts for a sample tenant (we can do a redacted export), and (2) are you requesting evidence in a timeboxed archive (zip) or as discrete files in a shared Drive folder?

If you prefer the call, we can do 30 minutes on Monday at 11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Security, Redwood Inference
[attachment: RI-KMS-Summary.pdf (PDF)]

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@latticeworks.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: security-review@latticeworks.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-19T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP — SIG/ISO/SOC2: control mapping and evidence requests

Thanks, team — this plan works. A few confirmations: 

- Please include the SOC 2 Type II executive summary in the Drive (redacted) and the control crosswalk spreadsheet as the primary artifact.
- For KMS proof, redacted rotation logs and a signed policy excerpt are ideal. We do not need full tenant telemetry exports for the first pass — screenshots/redacted samples are fine.
- Please upload everything to the Drive folder and share a single zipped archive as a backup.
- Confirmed: 30-min call Monday 2027-10-18 at 11:00 PT (Alex + security-review). If you need to reschedule, let us know.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Alex Mercer
Procurement Lead — LatticeWorks
[Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-crosswalk]
